programmes.d: Indians trap a bank robber (Dale Robertson), a beauty (Linda Darnell), a bank clerk (John Lund) and other stagecoach passengers in a gully.
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.
Reverend Tuttle is aboard a stagecoach when it is robbed by three masked gunmen, and Hollister believes that Big Jim Sten and his men may be to blame.
During a shootout, Hode is killed and Jett vows to take his revenge on Hollister for his death.
Mark's finding of the body of a murder victim starts Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshal Torrance on a search for the killer.
A band of Indians kidnaps Mark and disappears into the hills.

Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas; Lucas must clear his name and stop the reckless ambition of his replacement.
When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.
Bat takes control of a mining claim after winning a lottery and ventures out to locate it, running afoul of a giant who attacks him and throws him in the Trinity River.
Bat becomes the special prosecutor in the trial of a local thug, determined to conduct a fair trial despite the thug's boss, Sam Shanks, insisting upon a not-guilty verdict.
General Wheeler heads to New Orleans under orders to break up a nation-wide counterfeiting gang.
Yancy travels to Missouri to help a friend standing trial for a murder he didn't commit.
Matt teams with Pat Garrett after a large herd of horses is stolen.
Matt and Frankie go to Kansas City to aid in the capture of outlaw brothers Frank and Jesse James.
Josh loses his prisoner to Indians and then has to fight his way through the desert.
A boy hires Josh to bring in Santa Claus.
Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.
When the Apache chief leads a raid on a train depot, looking for weapons and provisions, one of his braves is captured.

Despite their position undercover as members of the infamous Quantrill gang, Matt and Frankie cannot stop them from carrying out a vicious massacre in Lawrence, Kan.; Matt sets out to hunt down Quantrill for what happened.
Matt and Frankie investigate a woman's suspicious cattle ranch amid a crisis threatening competing ranches in Sweetwater, Wyo.
A bounty hunter's need for vengeance emerges when he learns the outlaw he's escorting is related to his wife's killer.
A deputy tracks a murderer.
Bitterness ruins a patriarch.
A huge gold shipment is sent out without guards.
Brothers stand on opposite sides of the law.
An accident makes a temporary hero of a weak, pathetic man.
A bandit's carefully planned bank robbery takes a deadly turn.
Hoppy protects a professor and his daughter from claim jumpers.
Hoppy tracks a counterfeiting ring.
Doc Haley tangles with the owner of the water company regarding impure water.
Matt thinks twice before about arresting Alonzo Hicks.
